steps: Create src/prediction_data/gold/accounting.py with PositionState dataclass (wallet, platform, market_id, outcome_id, qty, avg_cost, cost_basis_usd, last_fill_ts)
Implement apply_fill() method: given a fill (side, qty_delta, price, fees), compute new qty, new avg_cost, realized_pnl
For buys: new_avg_cost = (old_qty * old_avg_cost + qty_delta * price) / (old_qty + qty_delta)
For sells: realized_pnl = qty_delta * (price - avg_cost), qty decreases, avg_cost unchanged
Handle position closing (qty → 0): emit final realized PnL, mark position as closed
Handle position flipping (long → short via oversized sell): split into close + open
Write comprehensive unit tests with known trade sequences and expected PnL values

description: Convert Silver trades into maker + taker fill events

For each Silver trade row, emit 2 fill records: one for maker (wallet=maker, side=maker_direction) and one for taker (wallet=taker, side=taker_direction)
Each fill contains: ts, wallet, platform, market_id, outcome_id, side, qty_delta, price, fees_usd
Map nonusdc_side (token1/token2) to outcome_id via dim_outcome lookup
Sort fills by timestamp before processing (critical for correct accounting)
Write unit tests verifying 1 trade → 2 fills with correct sides

Write ledger rows to S3 Gold Parquet (partitioned by day)
Write ClickHouse DDL for wallet_position_ledger (MergeTree, ORDER BY (wallet, ts), TTL 30 days)
Implement CH loader for ledger table
Write integration test: process known trades → verify ledger output matches expected
